title: fix: run local Enter + gen without the SOPS key
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Fixed local Enter and gen development without a SOPS key: both decrypt-vars scripts keep an existing .dev.vars or copy .dev.vars.example when SOPS is missing or exits 128; other SOPS errors still fail, and maintainers with a key retain the same decrypted vars. Gen now shares Enter's .wrangler/state D1 database and has a .dev.vars.example with the matching BETTER_AUTH_SECRET placeholder, so local sign-in sessions work across both services. Enter's local worker is named pollinations-enter, restoring gen's ENTER binding for /account/* requests. Added an idempotent npm run seed:local command that gives each local user at least 1,000,000 Quest Pollen in the shared D1 database instead of requiring hand-written SQL.
